evidence.curator_note: ARCS ACTUALLY DRAWN: ZERO. As for 8.115a, the equation carries one plain reaction arrow and no curved arrows, no fishhooks and no reaction-type label; all eight moves encoded here are curator-constructed. WHY THIS IS A SEPARATE RECORD: the book prints TWO products joined by 'and'. The second, 'm/z 196, 100%', is drawn as the same ring 'A' but with (CH3)3SiO- (bearing '+.') on the ring carbon, a ring C=C from that carbon, the same exocyclic =CH2 and the same methyl -- C11H20OSi+., m/z 196.128. Its TMS therefore sits on the ring-A oxygen, whereas the drawn substrate carries its TMS on the far end of the C24 side chain: the ion can only arise if the silyl group MIGRATES the whole length of the molecule first, which is precisely the 'other rearrangement' this section is about. WHAT IS CURATOR-ASSIGNED: (i) moves 1-4, the migration itself, encoded as a closed 2-electron cascade - C3=O pi -> O3-Si; Si-O24 sigma -> O24-H; C6-H -> C5=C6; C4=C5 pi -> C3=C4 - which converts the 4-en-3-one into the well known 3-silyloxy-3,5-diene and leaves a free 24-OH on the neutral; (ii) moves 5-8, the same ring-B double cleavage as 8.115a, here delivering H(C8) to C6 and H(C11) to C10, which is what the drawn ion demands (its C6 is a =CH2 with two hydrogens and its C10 carries one). ENCODING OF THE HYDROGEN TRANSFERS: hydrogens are implicit in the mapped SMILES (RDKit's parser deletes mapped [H] atoms, so an H cannot carry an atom map here), so each hydrogen shift is encoded as a two-electron atom->atom move from the donor heavy atom to the acceptor heavy atom - the convention already used in this corpus, e.g. IMS4-EQ4.33; move 2 (Si-O24 pair -> O24 non-bonding) and move 3 (C6-H pair -> C5=C6 pi) are the two halves of the C6-H -> O24-H transfer written the same way. The heavy-atom bond ledger is complete on its own: every sigma/pi bond that changes order is accounted for by a bond->bond move. The book draws neither the dienol-ether intermediate nor the neutral (C16H26O with C7=C8, C9=C11 and the 24-OH), so no intermediate state is asserted here.

NO MØD RULE IS CROSS-LINKED, and this was CHECKED, not assumed (convention E). rule_index.json 'by_equation' has no '8.115' key at all -- its chapter-8 index runs 8.1-8.14 only (German-edition numbering), so nothing in src/data_generation/rules/ is authored for this equation. There is in addition no silicon chemistry anywhere in the rule set (no rule pattern contains Si), so a trimethylsilyl migration cannot be expressed by any existing rule; that was checked by searching the rule DFS strings in rule_index.json for 'Si', which returns nothing.
